question: Does a corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized (fixing _common_prefix_and_suffix double-prefix so full B identifiers bind correctly) enable a real LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini 15 steps, Playwright, 4096 tokens, temp 0, seed 42) on true WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out (>=10 families, >=60 tasks, 49 templates, measured duplication 0.9479) to achieve EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with zero unsubstituted templates, success margin >=0.12 vs B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY/B-INSTR, false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15] with ECE <=0.15, and honest amortized saving >=25% vs COLD and <=0.85x vs RAG with family-stratified bootstrap CIs and deterministic verification?
hypothesis: A committed kernel fix to _common_prefix_and_suffix / _extract_varying_values / _field_path_to_slot_name in src/spider/kernel.py (distinct slot per field-path: url/path, body.*, headers.*, structure_similarity >=0.75, field-path relevance filter, full-value B identifiers bind without double-prefix, template = prefix + ${slot} + suffix where prefix/suffix are longest common prefix/suffix of A values and binding substitutes only the varying middle) enables distill_parameterized() to induce one parameterized mechanism per family at confidence 0.90 via MechanismRegistry. When a real LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, temp 0, seed 42, max 15 Playwright steps, max 4096 output tokens, identical toolset navigate/click/fill/type/select/goBack/observe) resolves via SpiderKernel.resolve() with required_slots = parameter_slots ∪ _template_slots(action_template) and deterministic verify() via _matches(postconditions, observed DOM/response) on nginx HIT-cache provenance (actual DOM/response state), it will on never-observed B identifiers (zero value overlap A vs B, family hold-out, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479 measured not hardcoded, AX 0.9 longest-prefix mapping) achieve: H1-mechanism EXECUTABLE >=0.75, binding correctness >=0.90 (exact expected_bound_action equality, zero unsubstituted ${}), H1-success >=0.12 absolute margin vs each of B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY/B-INSTR (family-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.02), H1-safety false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15] with ECE <=0.15, H1-economics honest amortized saving >=25% vs COLD and cost ratio <=0.85x vs RAG at f=10 (distill 1000 tok only SPIDER, 5000 bootstrap family-stratified CIs).
falsifier: FALSIFIED if ANY primary gate fails with valid measurement (status COMPLETE): F1-mechanism EXECUTABLE <0.75 or binding correctness <0.90 (Wilson lower <0.80) or any EXECUTABLE contains unsubstituted ${} (template bound incorrectly due to residual double-prefix or distinct-slot collision); F2-success SPIDER success <0.55 or not > B-COLD by >=0.12 and not > B-RAG by >=0.12 and not > B-REPLAY by >=0.12 and not > B-INSTR by >=0.10 (family-stratified bootstrap CI overlapping 0); F3-safety false_accept >0.15 or UNKNOWN on valid B outside [0.00,0.15] or ECE >0.15 or B-LITERAL success >0.15 (literal still solves held-out, proving parameterization unnecessary at duplication 0.9479); F4-economics amortized cost per success SPIDER >= B-COLD (saving <25%) or >= B-RAG (ratio >0.85) with CI crossing 1.0. MIXED if F2 fails but F1 passes (mechanism binds correctly but downstream agent/verification fails, separating induction from execution). MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not falsification) if: kernel fix not committed to src/spider/kernel.py (audit import/hash check fails, monkey-patch only), harness cannot induce distinct slots (collision), registry/resolve not exercising real required_slots/_bind, verification bypass (no _matches postcondition, verification_passed forced True), <60 valid tasks after dedup 0.9479 filtering, value overlap A∩B !=0 for parameterized slots, Playwright verification broken (no DOM/response provenance, no nginx HIT/SWR/SIE/304 discrimination), or LLM API unavailable for >50% trials after 3x exponential backoff (per AGENTS.md failure discipline).

baselines.description: Cold LLM agent with no SPIDER memory: same model gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 temp 0 seed 42, same Playwright toolset, same budget (15 steps, 4096 tokens, 30s/step timeout), same prompt scaffold without retrieved mechanisms. Cost = measured LLM input+output tokens (API usage/tiktoken) + browser calls (count + wall ms) + latency per task. No retrieval, no verification shortcut, no distill. Upper-bound re-exploration cost. Same held-out B family set.
baselines.expected: Success lower than SPIDER on held-out families; cost flat vs novelty; denominator for saving ratio. SPIDER expected >= COLD +0.12 with stratified CI lower >0.02.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same LLM/tools/budget, prompt injected with natural-language site procedure (e.g., shopping flow) but no parameterized mechanism or retrieval. Instruction tokens 200 amortized over f=10 => 20 tok/task (only INSTR bears this cost). Agent must discover B identifiers via exploration. Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without param slots. Same B set, same verification _matches.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below COLD but above SPIDER; success below SPIDER on multi-param families. SPIDER expected > INSTR by >=0.10 success and measurably cheaper amortized.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior A trajectories: same LLM/tools/budget, retrieves nearest successful trajectory from training pool A by Jaccard over intent+state keywords (threshold 0.30, same as pre-2.0 Graph), replays verbatim without parameter induction. Retrieval cost 200 tok + measured ms per task. Verification determines reuse: if retrieved identifiers exactly match test B per postcondition exact equality, reuse at 0 LLM tokens for matching prefix; else fallback to COLD LLM exploration for mismatched steps. Hit/miss measured via verification outcomes. Family hold-out ensures most misses on B.
baselines.expected: At most 1-2 families with incidental overlap (duplication 0.9479) may hit; overall success << SPIDER because without parameterization every novel B identifier triggers fallback. SPIDER expected >= RAG +0.12 success and cost <=0.85x RAG amortized (distill only SPIDER).

baselines.description: 0-token exact replay (TERX/BrowserBash equivalent) with LLM fallback: if test task full parameterized identifier sequence (path+body+headers action_template including varying fields) exactly equals a training trajectory A via exact string equality (no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens +1 verification browser call (50 tok nginx HIT provenance, 90ms) +1 browser execution; otherwise verification fails and fallback to COLD LLM cost for full task. Strongest exact-repeat economics baseline. Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = COLD. Hit_rate measured inside compared set (expected ~0.0 on family hold-out, ~1.0 on same-family control). Same LLM/budget on fallback path.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0 on held-out families by design (B never observed) -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY on held-out (SPIDER EXECUTABLE at 1000/f amortized) and within 2x of REPLAY on same-resource control where REPLAY hits at 50 tok.

baselines.description: Literal (zero-parameter) mechanism replay ablation: distill literal mechanisms via current kernel.distill() without parameter induction and attempt resolve on B via exact registry match (no slots). Tests that parameterization is necessary; validates duplication 0.9479 does not trivialize task. Same _bind/resolve path but parameter_slots=[]; same verification.
baselines.expected: Success ~0.0 on held-out B, EXECUTABLE 0.0 or binding fails, confirming literal cannot handle novelty. Any SPIDER success must be due to param slots, not trivial match. Gate: B-LITERAL success <=0.15.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls exercising real pipeline via committed kernel path (not monkey-patched): (PC1) Same-resource literal hit: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with identical identifiers via B-REPLAY exact string equality + deterministic _matches verification must achieve 100% success with 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call (50 tok, nginx HIT provenance, measured) and hit_rate=1.0 on same-A holdout (5 tasks). Validates 0-cost measurement and Playwright+nginx verification substrate. (PC2) Multi-param regression on same-A: harness distill_parameterized from 3 A observations with path+body+headers varying (same induction as SPIDER, same kernel fix, structure_similarity >=0.75, field-path relevance) tested on same A pool via actual registry/required_slots/_bind/verify must resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action (binding correctness 1.0 exact equality) and success >=0.90. Confirms induction works before generalization to B. Both use measured verification outcomes via kernel.verify/_matches on actual DOM/response, not forced constants.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: hit_rate 1.0, cost 50 tok, 1 browser call, success 1.0 measured via verification. PC2: EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding 1.0, success >=0.90. Failure due to binding double-prefix residual or verification bypass -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification.

null_control.description: Two null controls exercising real semantics via committed kernel registry/_bind/verify (not hardcoded): (NC1) Shuffled slot mapping: randomly permute learned parameter_slots -> identifier binding (e.g., swap ${sku} with ${store_id} or ${url} misassignment) before SPIDER resolve on same held-out B tasks via actual registry/_bind/verify; each task incurs real retrieval+verify+fallback costs based on verification outcomes (mismatched binds fail _matches and trigger 1-step repair 500 tok +2 browser calls, introducing variance). Expected success <= B-COLD +0.05, false_accept >=0.25, binding correctness <0.50, proving transfer requires correct parameterization not any reuse. (NC2) Random retrieval: SPIDER retrieval returns random registry entry instead of family-ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual Jaccard ranking path; expected cost flat, false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD, demonstrating ranking/gating matters. Both go through actual binding/verification so they CAN fail expected null pattern if mapping matters (not guaranteed flat); strong signal is NC success >= SPIDER -0.05 would make SPIDER effect spurious (task difficulty confounded -> measurement invalid for param-inherit claim).
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05, false_accept >=0.25, binding <0.50. NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD. If NC1 success >= SPIDER -0.05, observed SPIDER effect is spurious.

measurement_validity: 1. Real LLM execution (not token proxy): same model gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 temp 0 seed 42, identical Playwright toolset (navigate, click, fill, type, select, goBack, observe DOM/CDP), identical budget (max 15 steps, max 4096 output tokens, 30s/step timeout) across SPIDER/COLD/INSTR/RAG/REPLAY on identical held-out B set. Each task cost = measured LLM input+output tokens (API usage, tiktoken fallback), browser calls (count + wall ms), retrieval tokens/latency (200 tok+measured ms if SPIDER/RAG), verification tokens/latency (50 tok+measured ms if EXECUTABLE attempted via nginx HIT/SWR/SIE/304 provenance reading actual DOM/response), repair tokens/calls if verification fails (_matches fails -> 1 LLM repair step 500 tok +2 browser calls). Distill cost 1000 tok amortized over f=10 added ONLY to SPIDER for honest amortized comparison (no formula-from-novelty cost). 3x exponential backoff per task; LLM_API_available logged; >50% failures -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID per AGENTS.md.

2. Family hold-out with zero B overlap on true WebArena-Verified v2: load via Intel-validated census (codex EXP-INTEL-35749371101: 192 tasks, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479 measured, AX 0.9 longest-prefix on 20 CDP trees at 1280x720, PC1_WEB_SEARCH PASS) from repo cache /tmp/webarena, data/webarena_verified_v2.json, or verified CSV (3 fetch attempts logged). Deduplicate by template+intent hash; keep one exemplar per duplicate cluster; require >=10 families with >=3 tasks each, each family has >=2 resource pools A/B with disjoint identifiers (SKU, store, user, issue IDs). Training uses 3-5 exemplars from A only; test B values have zero exact value overlap with A for parameterized slots (verified value set intersection =0, logged per family). Family hold-out (not random split) prevents site identity leakage; hold-out families never seen during distill. Source, duplication handling (measured 0.9479, not hardcoded), family split, AX mapping, and value overlap logged in provenance.json; claim ceiling bounded to WebArena-Verified v2 or disclosed fallback (not synthetic-mock-as-proof). Minimum 60 valid tasks (6 per family) for decision; target 72-120.

3. Committed kernel-integrated distill_parameterized fixing double-prefix: fix in src/spider/kernel.py (verified by audit import+hash, not run_experiment.py monkey-patch) with helpers _common_prefix_and_suffix, _field_path_to_slot_name, _extract_varying_values supporting path+body+headers distinct slot naming per field-path (e.g., body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Request-ID -> ${request_id}, path segment -> ${store_id}), structure_similarity >=0.75 and field-path relevance filter (only action-template-relevant paths: url/path, body.*, headers.* excluding top-level metadata/noise). Registry stores one parameterized mechanism per family at confidence 0.90 via actual MechanismRegistry write/read. At resolve: required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template); freshness via behavioral_score >=0.25 (nginx HIT provenance if available) and confidence gating <0.80 -> UNKNOWN abstention (and <0.80 is do_not_assume gaming check); if UNKNOWN -> fallback to COLD LLM cost; if EXECUTABLE -> bound_action = _bind(action_template, params) via committed _bind (handles full-value B identifiers without prefix duplication: template = common_prefix + ${slot} + common_suffix extracted from A values only, binding substitutes varying middle correctly). No forced constants; all rates verification-derived with genuine variance. Audit verifies kernel path and that _common_prefix_and_suffix on disjoint A/B pools (e.g., A_SKU_00_000.. vs B_SKU_00_000..) yields template ${sku} or prefix-free correctly and B_SKU_00_000 binds exactly, not A_SKU_00_00B_SKU_00_000.

4. Strong baseline execution on identical held-out set with same verification: all baselines run on same family hold-out B tasks with identical LLM/tools/budget and same deterministic _matches postcondition verification on observed DOM/response state via nginx provenance (not LLM-as-judge). B-RAG retrieval uses Jaccard threshold 0.30 and success follows verification (retrievable only if template matches via exact param equality). B-REPLAY uses exact action_template string equality to decide hit/miss. B-INSTR instruction tokens correctly amortized as 200/f only to INSTR. B-LITERAL uses literal kernel distill without slots. No baseline handicapped; all costs measured same units (tokens, ms, calls) with per-task variance.

5. End-to-end cost accounting with honest amortization and family-stratified uncertainty: per-task cost measured as above; amortized cost per success = (total_tokens + distill_tokens/f)/success_rate where distill_tokens 1000 added only to SPIDER and instruction_tokens 200 as 200/f only to INSTR. Report raw per-task and amortized f=1,10,100 with bootstrap 5000 stratified by family for CI on cost ratios and success deltas, Wilson 95% CI for rates, McNemar or paired family-block bootstrap for success comparisons. Latency includes LLM + browser + retrieval + verification + repair. Token, browser, latency reported separately and combined.

6. Deterministic verification and calibration: verification is _matches(postconditions, observed_state) on actual Playwright DOM + nginx response provenance (status+headers+body digest) after execution, not LLM-as-judge. Verification AUROC and false_accept/false_reject measured vs true task success (postcondition equality). Report verification success vs true success correlation. UNKNOWN abstention measured per family (UNKNOWN when confidence <0.80 or required_slots missing or behavioral_score <0.25); report ECE (expected calibration error) for confidence vs success. Freshness guard behavioral_score exercised via runtime nginx substrate if available. Zero unsubstituted ${} checked via regex on bound_action.

7. Statistics honoring family structure and power: primary success comparison SPIDER vs each baseline uses paired family-stratified bootstrap (family as block, 5000 resamples) with two-sided p<0.05 and family-clustered SE; power >0.80 to detect 0.12 success delta at n>=60 per condition (power analysis n=60, alpha 0.05, baseline 0.45 -> delta 0.12 power 0.82). Binding correctness and EXECUTABLE rate Wilson 95% CI (lower >=0.80 for binding). Cost ratio CIs via family-stratified bootstrap. No degenerate 5-bin Spearman with ties; family-clustered permutation for null controls. Significance requires both primary success margin and EXECUTABLE/binding gates (C1+C2). Unknown handling preserves raw evidence (per-task CSV 72+ rows with COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR/NC rows, registry.jsonl per-family, cost_config.json, bound_action exact equality logs, Playwright traces sampled).

8. Prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement; code (src/spider/kernel.py hash, registry.py, models.py), fixtures (WebArena-Verified v2 CSV hash, family split), model version (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18), prompt scaffold, and decision thresholds hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42, LLM seed 42) logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with tokens, calls, latency, success, bound_action, verification, UNKNOWN, false_accept per condition; registry JSONL with slots/templates/confidence; cost_config JSON; Playwright traces sampled; provenance with run id, commits, hashes, LLM_API_available, AX 0.9 mapping proof.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of (C1)-(C6) measured via actual LLM+Playwright+nginx pipeline with committed kernel fix (audit verifies import+hash, not proxy): (C1) SPIDER success on held-out B M-SUCCESS-SPIDER >=0.65? No - threshold per director is success margin, but mechanism needs success itself: require M-SUCCESS-SPIDER >=0.60 and > B-COLD by >=0.12 absolute (family-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.02) and > B-RAG by >=0.12 and > B-REPLAY by >=0.12 and > B-INSTR by >=0.10 (Wilson lower for SPIDER >=0.48); (C2) mechanism quality M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER >=0.75 and M-BINDING-CORRECT >=0.90 (Wilson lower >=0.80) with M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES ==0 among EXECUTABLE (exact expected_bound_action equality check, no double-prefix residual); (C3) safety M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER <=0.10 and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-SPIDER in [0.00,0.15] on valid B (no excessive abstention) and M-ECE-SPIDER <=0.15 and B-LITERAL success <=0.15 on same B (literal fails, parameterization necessary); (C4) economics M-AMORTIZED-COST-PER-SUCCESS-SPIDER-F10 (distill 1000/f only SPIDER) >=25% cheaper vs COLD (M-COST-RATIO-SPIDER-vs-COLD-F10 <=0.75) and <=0.85x vs RAG (M-COST-RATIO-SPIDER-vs-RAG-F10 <=0.85) with family-stratified bootstrap CI upper <1.0 (f=10 primary; f=1/100 sensitivity reported); (C5) positive controls: PC1 same-A B-REPLAY hit_rate 1.0 cost 50 tok success 1.0 PASS (validates 0-token measurement + nginx verification) and PC2 multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0 binding 1.0 success >=0.90 PASS; (C6) null controls freshness/abstention: NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05 and false_accept >=0.25 and NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD (real bind/verify variance, not flat constants), and UNKNOWN cases have confidence <0.80 or required_slots missing, ECE <=0.15. FALSIFIED if any C1-C4 fails (excluding PC/NC substrate failures which are MEASUREMENT_INVALID). MIXED if C1 fails but C2 passes (binds correctly but agent fails downstream verification/repair - mechanism quality vs execution separated). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if kernel fix not committed, slot collision, registry/resolve not exercising real required_slots/_bind, verification bypass (forced True), <60 valid tasks after dedup, value overlap A∩B !=0, or LLM API unavailable >50% (substrate failure, not falsification). All thresholds frozen; primary outcome is C1 success margin together with C2 mechanism quality.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances from EXPERIMENTAL (narrow synthetic ceilings: 5.42% single-param POC 10 identifiers audit PASS, harness-only multi-param 21/21 binding not kernel, plus prior MEASUREMENT_INVALID 0/72 binding correctness due to double-prefix) to VALIDATED at bounded real-LLM multi-param ceiling (WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out >=10 families >=60 tasks, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479 measured, AX 0.9, path+body+headers distinct slots, real Playwright+nginx verification, beats COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR by >=0.12 with false_accept <=0.10, honest f=10 economics). Establishes first audited live-browser evidence that multi-parameter mechanisms learned on A generalize to never-observed B via correct bound_action and quantified economics (25% saving vs COLD, <=0.85x vs RAG), closing synthetic->real gap for 59/60 C-WEB-DYNAMICS synthetic-dominated prior and unblocking C-LLM-INHERIT (real LLM inheritance vs strong baselines gate) and C-PRODUCT-ECON (honest amortized economics, not 5.42% fragile extrapolation) for scale-up to Docker full-DOM hosting. Authorizes kernel promotion of corrected distill_parameterized with distinct slot naming and double-prefix fix to src/spider/kernel.py (promotion_ready true pending kernel tests and audit PASS). No immediate SHIPPED; requires replication on production WebArena hosting and freshness guard hardening before SHIPPED.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at narrow synthetic ceiling (or bounded REJECTED for multi-param real-LLM transfer on WebArena-Verified v2: corrected kernel still does not beat cold/retrieval/replay on held-out families where duplication 0.9479 still requires genuine parameterization but replay already misses). If MIXED (binds correctly per C2 but no C1 success margin), mechanism binds but downstream agent/verification/repair fails -> product must fix Playwright execution, _matches postconditions, or agent prompt (not induction) before re-test. If SPIDER not beating B-RAG/B-REPLAY (where both miss on hold-out), multi-param inheritance adds no economics beyond retrieval/replay, supporting tool/API-bypass and caching-vs-generalization tension that exact replay dominates at family hold-out and parameterized template with repair only wins when repair loop exists; Product should redirect from param-inherit scale-up to higher-leverage claims per Director: C-FRESHNESS (freshness guards, UNKNOWN abstention, distributed session/behavioral_score), C-DELTA-REPAIR (localized repair on nginx HIT/SWR/SIE verified substrate per runtime dependency), or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE (calibrated resolution without internal ids), and defer C-PRODUCT-ECON Docker scale-up. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID (fix not committed, verification broken, <60 tasks, value overlap, LLM keys unavailable), priority is fixing kernel integration (_common_prefix_and_suffix distinct slot naming per field-path + full-value B handling) and runtime verification AUROC/byte-preserving replay substrate before re-testing param-inherit economics. Negative result still high-information: definitively closes real-LLM multi-param transfer at this substrate and informs whether 49-template family hold-out justifies productization vs redirection after 37 total attempts and 15+ synthetic divergence variants.
estimated_cost: Real LLM API calls: target 72-120 B tasks (10-12 families x6-10) x5 conditions (SPIDER/COLD/INSTR/RAG/REPLAY) =360-600 agent runs +10 positive controls (PC1/PC2) +120-144 null controls (NC1/NC2) +72 B-LITERAL = ~562-846 runs. Each run: average 8-12 LLM calls (agent steps) x ~1500 tokens avg = ~12k-18k tokens input+output ~ $0.03-0.07 per run at gpt-4o-mini pricing ($0.15/1M in, $0.60/1M out) plus retrieval 200 tok (RAG) and verification 50 tok. Total $20-55 at 72 tasks, $35-60 at 120 tasks (budget cap $60). Retrieval/verification/browser (Playwright chromium headless on cached WebArena HTML or Flask mock if WebArena inaccessible after 3 attempts) negligible extra. Wall-clock ~60-90 min on GitHub Actions (parallel batching 4 concurrent agents, 30s/step timeout). Storage: per-task CSV ~800 rows with all conditions, registry JSONL per-family (10-12 mechanisms), cost_config.json, bound_action exact equality logs, Playwright traces sampled, provenance (model version, prompt hash, seeds 42, AX mapping). Early abort with failure.json if LLM budget exceeded or API >50% unavailable.

Resolves starved-claim bottleneck (0/60 recent, 4 consecutive zero-LLM product experiments) and tunneling flags (runtime 10/10 C-MEAS-VALID localhost decompression, graph 8/10 C-FRESHNESS narrow mock, frontier synthetic TV) by testing highest-leverage product mechanism with strong baselines, deterministic verification, and family-stratified economics per Director REOPEN rationale.
